```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(coda)
library(runjags)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r load-data}
data <- read.csv("NEW_updated_model_data.csv")
```

```{r model-string}
# MODEL STRING — Bayesian logistic regression using dbern with logit link
modelString <- "
model {
  for (i in 1:N) {
    y[i] ~ dbern(p[i])
    logit(p[i]) <- beta0 + beta1*x_Offense_TotYd[i] +
                   beta2*x_Defense_TotYd[i] +
                   beta3*x_Offense_TO[i] +
                   beta4*x_Defense_TO[i] +
                   beta5*x_Team_Score[i] +
                   beta6*x_Opponent_Score[i]
  }

  ## Priors
  beta0 ~ dnorm(mu0, g0)
  beta1 ~ dnorm(mu1, g1)
  beta2 ~ dnorm(mu2, g2)
  beta3 ~ dnorm(mu3, g3)
  beta4 ~ dnorm(mu4, g4)
  beta5 ~ dnorm(mu5, g5)
  beta6 ~ dnorm(mu6, g6)
}
"
```

```{r data-prep}
# DATA PREPARATION
the_data <- list(
  y  = as.integer(data$Win),   # dbern requires integer 0/1
  x_Offense_TotYd = as.vector(data$Offense_TotYd),
  x_Defense_TotYd = as.vector(data$Defense_TotYd),
  x_Offense_TO = as.vector(data$Offense_TO),
  x_Defense_TO = as.vector(data$Defense_TO),
  x_Team_Score = as.vector(data$Team_Score),
  x_Opponent_Score = as.vector(data$Opponent_Score),
  N = nrow(data),
  mu0 = 0, g0 = 1,
  mu1 = 0, g1 = 1,
  mu2 = 0, g2 = 1,
  mu3 = 0, g3 = 1,
  mu4 = 0, g4 = 1,
  mu5 = 0, g5 = 1,
  mu6 = 0, g6 = 1
  
)

initsfunction <- function(chain) {
  .RNG.seed <- c(1, 2)[chain]
  .RNG.name <- c("base::Super-Duper", "base::Wichmann-Hill")[chain]
  return(list(.RNG.seed = .RNG.seed, .RNG.name = .RNG.name))
}

posterior_MLR <- run.jags(
  modelString,
  n.chains = 1,
  data     = the_data,
  monitor  = c("beta0","beta1","beta2","beta3","beta4","beta5","beta6"),
  adapt    = 1000,
  burnin   = 5000,
  sample   = 5000,
  thin     = 60,
  inits    = initsfunction
)
```

```{r diagnostics}
summary(posterior_MLR)
plot(posterior_MLR, vars = c("beta0","beta1","beta2","beta3","beta4","beta5","beta6"))
```

```{r density-plots}
post <- as.mcmc(posterior_MLR)
post %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  gather(parameter, value) -> post2

ggplot(post2, aes(value)) +
  geom_density() +
  facet_wrap(~ parameter, ncol = 3) +
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(size = 8))
```

```{r predict-function}
# PREDICTION FUNCTION
# Returns posterior distribution of win probability p in [0, 1]
# new_data keys must use x_ prefix: x_Offense_TotYd, x_Defense_TotYd, etc.
predict_mlr <- function(new_data, post_samples) {
  beta0 <- post_samples[, "beta0"]
  beta1 <- post_samples[, "beta1"]
  beta2 <- post_samples[, "beta2"]
  beta3 <- post_samples[, "beta3"]
  beta4 <- post_samples[, "beta4"]
  beta5 <- post_samples[, "beta5"]
  beta6 <- post_samples[, "beta6"]

  lp <- beta0 +
    beta1 * new_data$x_Offense_TotYd +
    beta2 * new_data$x_Defense_TotYd +
    beta3 * new_data$x_Offense_TO +
    beta4 * new_data$x_Defense_TO +
    beta5 * new_data$x_Team_Score +
    beta6 * new_data$x_Opponent_Score

  # Convert log-odds to probability via inverse logit — output is always in [0, 1]
  p_pred <- 1 / (1 + exp(-lp))
  return(p_pred)
}
```

```{r update-function}
# UPDATE MODEL FUNCTION
update_model <- function(previous_posterior, current_data, new_game) {
  post_samples <- as.matrix(previous_posterior$mcmc)
  post_means <- colMeans(post_samples)
  post_vars <- apply(post_samples, 2, var)

  # Update priors from posterior
  current_data$mu0 <- post_means["beta0"];  current_data$g0 <- 1 / post_vars["beta0"]
  current_data$mu1 <- post_means["beta1"];  current_data$g1 <- 1 / post_vars["beta1"]
  current_data$mu2 <- post_means["beta2"];  current_data$g2 <- 1 / post_vars["beta2"]
  current_data$mu3 <- post_means["beta3"];  current_data$g3 <- 1 / post_vars["beta3"]
  current_data$mu4 <- post_means["beta4"];  current_data$g4 <- 1 / post_vars["beta4"]
  current_data$mu5 <- post_means["beta5"];  current_data$g5 <- 1 / post_vars["beta5"]
  current_data$mu6 <- post_means["beta6"];  current_data$g6 <- 1 / post_vars["beta6"]
  # NOTE: no sigma/gamma update — removed since dbern has no variance parameter

  # Append new game
  current_data$y <- c(current_data$y, as.integer(new_game$Win))
  current_data$x_Offense_TotYd <- c(current_data$x_Offense_TotYd,  new_game$x_Offense_TotYd)
  current_data$x_Defense_TotYd <- c(current_data$x_Defense_TotYd,  new_game$x_Defense_TotYd)
  current_data$x_Offense_TO <- c(current_data$x_Offense_TO,new_game$x_Offense_TO)
  current_data$x_Defense_TO <- c(current_data$x_Defense_TO,new_game$x_Defense_TO)
  current_data$x_Team_Score <- c(current_data$x_Team_Score,new_game$x_Team_Score)
  current_data$x_Opponent_Score<- c(current_data$x_Opponent_Score, new_game$x_Opponent_Score)

  # Update N after appending
  current_data$N <- length(current_data$y)

  updated_posterior <- run.jags(
    modelString,
    n.chains = 1,
    data = current_data,
    monitor = c("beta0","beta1","beta2","beta3","beta4","beta5","beta6"),
    adapt = 1000,
    burnin = 5000,
    sample = 5000,
    thin = 60,
    inits = initsfunction
  )
  return(updated_posterior)
}
```

```{r new-games}
# NEW GAMES — keys use x_ prefix to match predict_mlr() and update_model()
new_games <- list(
  list(
    Win = 1,
    x_Offense_TotYd = 390,
    x_Defense_TotYd = 268,
    x_Offense_TO = 0,
    x_Defense_TO = 0,
    x_Team_Score = 24,
    x_Opponent_Score = 6
  ),
  list(
    Win = 0,
    x_Offense_TotYd = 405,
    x_Defense_TotYd = 301,
    x_Offense_TO = 1,
    x_Defense_TO = 0,
    x_Team_Score = 23,
    x_Opponent_Score = 20
  )
)
```

```{r iterate-games}
# ITERATE THROUGH NEW GAMES
predictions_list <- list()

for (i in seq_along(new_games)) {
  new_game <- new_games[[i]]

  # Predict BEFORE updating with this game's result
  predictions <- predict_mlr(new_game, as.matrix(posterior_MLR$mcmc))
  predictions_list[[i]] <- predictions

  print(paste("Predictions for Game", i))
  print(summary(predictions))

  # Win probability — predictions are already in [0,1] so just take the mean
  cat("Win probability:", mean(predictions), "\n\n")

  # Update model with this game's data
  posterior_MLR <- update_model(posterior_MLR, the_data, new_game)

  # Keep the_data in sync for next iteration
  the_data$y <- c(the_data$y, as.integer(new_game$Win))
  the_data$x_Offense_TotYd <- c(the_data$x_Offense_TotYd, new_game$x_Offense_TotYd)
  the_data$x_Defense_TotYd <- c(the_data$x_Defense_TotYd, new_game$x_Defense_TotYd)
  the_data$x_Offense_TO <- c(the_data$x_Offense_TO, new_game$x_Offense_TO)
  the_data$x_Defense_TO <- c(the_data$x_Defense_TO, new_game$x_Defense_TO)
  the_data$x_Team_Score <- c(the_data$x_Team_Score, new_game$x_Team_Score)
  the_data$x_Opponent_Score<- c(the_data$x_Opponent_Score, new_game$x_Opponent_Score)
  the_data$N <- length(the_data$y)
}
```

```{r results-table}
# RESULTS TABLE
predictions_df <- data.frame(
  Game = seq_along(predictions_list),
  Win_Probability = sapply(predictions_list, mean), 
  Lower_95 = sapply(predictions_list, quantile, 0.025),
  Upper_95 = sapply(predictions_list, quantile, 0.975)
)
print(predictions_df)
```

```{r plot-win-prob}
ggplot(predictions_df, aes(x = Game, y = Win_Probability)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Lower_95, ymax = Upper_95), width = 0.1) +
  ylim(0, 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Predicted Win Probability Over Games",
    x = "Game Number",
    y = "Win Probability"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
